new_source: New causal grammar, 72 public events: four 8-step corridors with roles sequence [0,1,2,3,0,1,2,3] and forward directions on target corridor, 8 cross-corridor joins and 32 distractors. All added edges from target path states have a role != required next role, other edges do not leave target nodes using required role. Full PUBLIC graph from target start has ONE valid eight-op endpoint. Source-only evaluator truth never online. 4 x8 true path edges, 8 joins, 32 distractors; no model prediction used to choose source cases.
controls: original F60+new eight-op public solver, unchanged T5 public 144B learned causal memory, zero-weight control, full 72-edge source exact unique solver; T7 source generator cannot select based on model outcomes
budget: 144-byte total records+weights+counter; actual training amortized over exactly 32 tasks; CPU and peak Python memory <= strongest valid frozen native F60 + solver; source birth/evaluator costs separately; no query until after online
admission: full public unique answer verified at source-first-use then trained native produces exact correct answer and preserves baseline-correct cases at equal/lower resources independently replicated; otherwise negative. Original public source T6 ambiguous observations cannot be reclassified.
